about: Preregistered case list for the retrospective calibration of Daylight Commons' post-level readouts (project-docs/CALIBRATION-STUDY.md). Fixed before any readout was run on any case. Cases are periods, not peoples: each is a place and a time window with a documented outcome. The study calibrates readouts; it never produces a risk score for any group, country or person.

outcomeKinds.atrocity: mass atrocity crimes documented by an international or national inquiry
outcomeKinds.tension-no-atrocity: a period of high tension with documented dangerous speech, followed by no mass atrocity, documented by observers

neededForAValidRun: Readout corpora that are samples of what people actually received in each window (full broadcasts, full feeds), not quotes chosen because they were dangerous: curated quotes make every readout look like a hit.
At least as many no-atrocity control periods as atrocity periods, matched on tension, with full samples.
A reviewer outside this workspace to check the case list, the outcome coding and the scoring before results are read.
